name: prop_wheel
prompt:
Comic art style of the reference: bold black ink outlines, flat cel shading, subtle halftone dots. One single object, centred: a big wooden hamster-style exercise wheel for cats, seen at a 3/4 angle from the front-left so you look INTO the drum, exactly like the wheel in the reference. The drum is wide, made of wooden slats, and it is attached to the stand only at ONE side by a short axle at the back. The inside of the drum and its front opening are COMPLETELY EMPTY: no spokes, no cross bars, no axle in front, nothing in the opening. A sturdy wooden A-frame stand behind the drum.
The background MUST be a solid flat pure chroma-key green (#00FF00) everywhere around the object, no gradient, no floor, no shadow, no scenery, no text. Do not use green on the object itself.
